description: Qualys Enterprise TruRisk Platform is a software designed to help organizations identify, assess, and manage cybersecurity risks across their IT environments. The software consolidates asset inventory, vulnerability management, and risk assessment into a unified solutionthat integrates with enterprise security tools. It enables continuous monitoring of networks, applications, and endpoints to detect vulnerabilities and misconfigurations. The software provides actionable insights for prioritizing remediation tasks based on risk scores and asset criticality. Through automation and customizable reporting features, it streamlines compliance requirements and supports decision-making for security teams. This platform addresses the business problem of reducing exposure to cyber threats and improving operational security posture.
